name: Spitter Pods
disable: DC 18 Crafting check to add disruptive chemicals to the fungus's reservoir, DC 18 Nature check (trained) to recognize how to constrict the chemicals' flow, or DC 20 Deception check (trained) to spread spores that befuddle the fungus; three total successes are required to disable the trap.
routine: (3 actions) The spitter pods alternate between making Strikes and Reloading. The pods lose 1 action for each successful check to disable the trap.

items.name: Unfurl
items.text:
A non-fungus creatures enters area E4

---

Effect The spitter pod rolls initiative.

text: Specialized spore pods burst open, expel toxic globules, and recharge from alchemical reservoirs.
